# CallDeskTech

> CallDeskTech (calldesk.tech) is an AI receptionist for small and local businesses. It deploys a low-latency AI phone assistant, powered by Retell AI, that answers incoming calls, books appointments, and answers customer questions in under 500ms.

## What it does

- Answers business phone calls with an AI voice agent (Retell AI, sub-500ms latency, semantic turn detection)
- Books appointments via calendar integration (Google, Outlook, iCal, through Cal.com)
- Answers caller questions from a business-specific knowledge base (uploaded FAQs or a scraped website)
- Lets businesses design conversation flows with a no-code flow builder
- Provides call analytics: call volume, booking rates, common questions
- Provides a dedicated phone number, or supports using an existing number, worldwide
- Sends SMS confirmations for booked appointments

## Who it's for

Local service businesses that take phone calls for appointments and customer questions, e.g. plumbers, salons, medical/dental clinics, restaurants, and auto repair shops.

## Key pages

- https://calldesk.tech/ - homepage and product overview
- https://calldesk.tech/demo - try a free interactive demo
- https://calldesk.tech/pricing - pricing and subscription checkout
- https://calldesk.tech/dashboard - business dashboard (calls, knowledge base, settings) for signed-in users
- https://calldesk.tech/onboarding - business setup flow (business profile, knowledge base, calendar, go-live)

## Pricing

- Lite: 2 cents per minute. An efficient engine with a clear, English-only voice. Voice: Clear and efficient. Response speed: Good. Reasoning: Good.
- Standard: 5 cents per minute. A fast, strong engine with a natural voice. Voice: Natural. Response speed: Fast. Reasoning: Strong.
- Pro: 9 cents per minute. Our strongest engine with our most expressive voice. Voice: Most expressive. Response speed: Fast. Reasoning: Strongest.
- Included on every plan: Call summary; Full transcript; Structured field extraction (name, reason for the call, and anything else you ask for); Call transfers; Keypad tones (DTMF); Knowledge base; Calendar booking; Call testing and live call monitoring; API and MCP server; 40+ languages (non-English languages need the Standard or Pro voice; Lite's voice is English only).
- Phone agents from 2 cents a minute. Lite 2 cents, Standard 5 cents and Pro 9 cents per minute, all available now.
- Every plan is bring-your-own carrier.
- Phone numbers from us, on any plan: Telnyx number $1.00 per month plus 1 cent per inbound minute; Twilio number (premium carrier: supports payments and our existing SMS setup) $2.00 per month plus 1.5 cents per inbound minute. Bring your own number or carrier: free.
- Expert backup on Lite and Standard: 1.5 cents more per minute while it is on, for better accuracy on hard turns.
- Standard with one Telnyx number and 500 inbound minutes a month: 500 x 5c + $1.00 + 500 x 1c = $31.00.
- Optional add-ons are coming soon and cannot be bought yet; amounts will be announced when they launch.
- Customers on an earlier flat per-minute price keep it.
